title: Atoms & Molecules
notes:
Atoms vs Molecules

Atom: Smallest part taking part in chemical reaction; does not exist freely.
Molecule: Smallest particle existing in a free state.
Homoatomic: He (monoatomic), H₂ (diatomic), P₄ (tetraatomic), S₈ (octaatomic).
Heteroatomic: CO₂, H₂O, NH₃, CH₄, SF₆.
summary: Definitions of atoms and homoatomic/heteroatomic molecules.
